notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
This is a bug-fix release that fixes
- an issue on Level 3 that prevented from getting through the mini-portals, and caused immediate death :S
- leaderboard loading problems

Many thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198231311032]Cannibal__cupcake[/url] for signaling this issue!
